previous_protocol_assessment.description: Historical Baseline experiments (Phase 2 & Phase 3) trained on legitimate subset of full dataset and evaluated against all 284,807 rows.
previous_protocol_assessment.accuracy_of_out_of_sample_label: Technically inaccurate for the legitimate partition because training instances were included in the evaluation set. Accurate only for fraudulent records and duplicate legitimate records.

leakage_safeguards: Class target column strictly excluded from all model feature matrices
Unsupervised model training restricted strictly to Class == 0 from training partition
Training fraud events strictly excluded from unsupervised fitting
TransactionPreprocessor fitted exclusively on training legitimate partition
Validation partition used strictly for threshold inspection
Test partition held out completely and evaluated exactly once
